steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: The food industry encompasses all stages from farm to fork: production, processing, manufacturing, distribution, retail, and food service. | Key Fact: Primary production: farming (arable, pastoral, mixed), fishing, and aquaculture (fish farming). | Key Fact: Food manufacturing transforms raw ingredients into processed products; the UK food manufacturing sector is the largest manufacturing sector by employment. | Key Fact: Distribution includes transport (road, rail, sea, air), cold chain logistics (refrigerated transport and storage), and warehousing.
